title: Coherent nerves of simplicial operator and string categories
statement:
Use the infinity-category and universe conventions of [def-coef-complete-algebroid]. Use the ordinary and generalized nonsymmetric infinity operads of [lem-coef-operadic-algebra-presentability]. Use simplicial categories and their coherent nerve $N_{\mathrm{hc}}$ as in [lem-coef-coherent-nerve-comparison]. A nonsymmetric simplicial multicategory $P$ has a small set of colors, simplicial operation sets $P(c_1,\ldots,c_n;d)$ for every finite ordered input list (including $n=0$), and associative unital substitution maps. Suppose every operation set is Kan. Its category of operators $P^\otimes$ has objects finite lists of colors and mapping sets
$$P^\otimes((c_1,\ldots,c_n),(d_1,\ldots,d_m))=\coprod_{\phi:[m]\to[n]}\prod_{i=1}^mP(c_{\phi(i-1)+1},\ldots,c_{\phi(i)};d_i),$$
with composition by substitution and projection to $\Delta^{\mathrm{op}}$. Then $N_{\mathrm{hc}}P^\otimes\to\Delta^{\mathrm{op}}$ is an ordinary nonsymmetric infinity operad; its fiber at $[1]$ is the coherent nerve of the unary simplicial category of $P$.

For any small locally Kan simplicial category $C$, let $D(C)$ have objects $(c_0,\ldots,c_n)$ and mapping sets
$$D(C)((c_0,\ldots,c_n),(d_0,\ldots,d_m))=\coprod_{\phi:[m]\to[n]}\prod_{i=0}^m C(c_{\phi(i)},d_i).$$
Its coherent nerve is the cocartesian fibration over $\Delta^{\mathrm{op}}$ classified by $[n]\mapsto(N_{\mathrm{hc}}C)^{n+1}$, with projections and diagonals as transition functors. These identifications are natural in simplicial functors. In particular, for a locally Kan simplicial groupoid it is a left fibration, and its $[n]$ fiber is $(N_{\mathrm{hc}}C)^{n+1}$.
